package rulefixtures

import "sync"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_caching_cache_miss_does_duplicate_work: Layer: Caching. Flag cache miss paths that allow concurrent duplicate recomputation for the same key.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
var (
	hitCount int
	missMu  sync.Mutex
)

func scenario510Positive(key string) string {
	missMu.Lock()
	hitCount++
	missMu.Unlock()

	// Lock released; expensive work runs without holding the mutex.
	// Multiple goroutines can compute the same key concurrently.
	// No singleflight or request deduplication.
	return expensiveCompute510(key)
}

func expensiveCompute510(key string) string {
	return "result:" + key
}
